newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Ballarat rejects Foster's takeover bid.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Ballarat rejects Foster's takeover bid.

text.p: Ballarat Brewing Co Ltd said on Tuesday that its independent directors had recommended that shareholders reject the takeover bid by Foster's Brewing Group Ltd unit Carlton and United Breweries.

"In the absence of a material change in circumstances, shareholders representing greater than 25 percent of Ballarat Brewing's shares, including your independent directors have advised the company that they intend to reject CUB's current offer," the tourism and leisure company said.
It cited a report from independent expert Grant Samuel which valued Ballarat shares at A$2.56 to A$2.93 each and on this basis concluded that the A$2.50 per share bid was not fair.
The company said the directors believed the bid by Foster's was opportunistic just like the A$2.45 per share bid by Guinness Peat Group Plc GPG.AX.
